text: {"assertions":["A data loss bug was identified in mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt affecting clients pinned to the v1 SDK.","The bug manifested as a local row missing after the app is relaunched.","The root cause was an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation in the offline cache code.","The fix involved prefetching the lazy relation with a single query instead of loading it on demand.","The bug was reproduced by force-stopping the app while it had unsynced edits pending.","The fix was implemented in PR #5175 on branch fix/data-loss-1.","After the fix, nightly rollup counts matched source counts consistently for 29 days, confirming the resolution."]}
